# Activity Vault

The all-in-one activity archive for teachers and after-school program teachers.
Hundreds of real, classic, public-domain activity concepts — filterable by age, time,
group size, materials, and category. Plan-my-week planner. Printable one-page cards.

## Categories
- Seasons: 8 activities — Activities that ride the turning year — fall leaves, winter making, spring planting, summer play.
- Holidays: 6 activities — Festive projects and games for the days the whole group looks forward to.
- Crafts: 21 activities — Hands-on making: fold it, paint it, build it, take it home.
- STEM: 11 activities — Experiments, engineering challenges, and satisfying science demos.
- PE & Movement: 14 activities — Run, jump, dance — activities that burn off the wiggles.
- Team & Community: 11 activities — Turn a group into a crew: cooperation, trust, and belonging.
- Icebreakers: 11 activities — First-day friendly: learn names, laugh, and loosen up fast.
- Outdoor: 18 activities — Fresh-air activities for fields, playgrounds, and nature walks.
- Rainy Day: 12 activities — Stuck inside? These keep a roomful of kids happy without a gym.
- Quiet & Focus: 19 activities — Wind-down worthy: calm, creative, individual or small-group.

## API
- api/v1/activities.json — full activity records
- api/v1/categories.json — category definitions
- api/v1/filters.json — filter configuration
- api/v1/schema/activity.schema.json — JSON schema
